name: verify
title_zh: 在终端里无头驱动引擎应用，录下全程验证视频并生成可点
tagline_zh: 跑验证时人不在屏幕前？它替你盯着 pty 里的每一步，自动录成视频，最后甩你一个带时间轴和检查项的网页，点开即复盘。
tagline_en: Run verification while you're away—it watches the pty, records every step, and hands you a clickable page with.
desc_en: Drive an engine app headlessly in a pty, record a video of the whole verification, and open a summary page (video + timeline + checks) with pixel open.
why_zh: 不是录屏工具，是在 pty 里直接驱动引擎应用，连输入输出都同步捕获，验证轨迹和视频天然对齐。
why_en: Not a screen recorder—it drives the engine app inside the pty, so input/output and video are inherently synced. No.
limit_zh: 只认能在 pty 里跑的引擎应用（如浏览器、CLI 工具）；图形界面应用得先有 headless 模式。
limit_en: Only works with pty-capable engine apps (e.g., browsers, CLIs); GUI apps need a headless mode. Video captures terminal output, not screen pixels.
